operations.title: WP24a: realizable level sets of r=a1/(DuDd) — 699/755 textures are single-cluster singletons; 56 span two clusters in exactly two class-locked patterns ((1,3): all 27 diagonal; (0,4): all 29 4cycle trivial/leafcol); paired minima are the same physical point (dchi2<=4.3e-12, dJ/J<=1.7e-8) related by a uniform generation-exchange swap/shift of log-magnitudes; no exact complementarity law (ledger 1954)
Figueiredo to Nima: WP24a level-set structure + generation-exchange mechanism
operations.body: WP24a (ledger 1954): the realizable r-spectrum per texture has at most 2 points. 699/755 singletons; 56 paired in exactly two class-locked patterns: (1,3) all diagonal class, (0,4) all 4cycle trivial/leafcol. Pairs are the same physical point (dchi2<=4.3e-12, dJ/J<=1.7e-8) related by a uniform log-magnitude transformation: (1,3) swaps the two off-diagonal u magnitudes by ±6.218726 (generation exchange of up-type eigenvalue assignment); (0,4) shifts by -6.218726. sin^2 sums not constant — no complementarity law. The same physical point carries two folded phases: more evidence phi is chart data, and the mechanism behind 1937's extra-valley coincidence. Certificate results/wp24a_level_set_structure.json (commit 639e4ac2).

operations.title: Figueiredo to Benincasa: WP24a — two charts, one physical point, explicit exchange map
operations.body: WP24a (ledger 1954): direct exhibition of your chart/quotient distinction inside the fit landscape. 56 textures each realize the SAME physical point in two charts with different folded phases; the exchange map is uniform and class-locked (generation swap for diagonal class, shift for 4cycle). The phi spectrum is therefore partly a chart-multiplicity artifact, not only a physical level structure. Residual: singleton-vs-paired selection within a class is uncharacterized.
